items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Donald Byrd, Ira Sullivan, Kenny Drew, myself, and Art Blakey.

ctx.x: And Philly Billy Joe got me one day and he said, 'man, I got a date with you.' Well, I'm kind of getting ahead of myself. When we played the Washington gig, we come back from New York and our next engagement was Atlantic City; see, in between time, I think we ... that's when I did that date with Lee Morgan. No, no ... not yet. That wouldn't be yet. I was still with Artie.

We played Atlantic City for a week. By that time, Donald Bird quit the band. What happened after we made the Washington engagement, we were supposed to play Newport, and Art come up late, but Donald had his car, and Ira and myself and Kenny Drew was riding with Artie, and he got messed up somehow, and we left late to drive up to Newport, and when we got there, the man was-- all you could hear was Louis Armstrong playing When the Saints Go Marching In ; that was the close of the show, and the man said, 'Well,…

hung up on the way, and stuff, and the man said, "I'm sorry, but you can't go in." And that was when Donald Byrd stopped it and u Well, Art, said, "I'm sorry, but I got a family and I got to make the gig."
